normalized.binding: The version in meaning persists through existing .wktensor codec. normalization is a derived optional descriptor; restore rejects mismatch if present and accepts its absence after codec. Same strict dtype/shape/layout/VAEhash as raw.

source.allZero: No ComfyUI high-level allzero skip is inserted. Rawzero components undergo the same explicit perchannel normalization.

ownership: Raw input validated through existing requireWanRawLatent without editinghelper. Host copies into private disjoint WASM arenas and copies results. Output shape array owned. Original buffers/metadata preserved and nottransferred.

security: Factory snapshots explicit bytes before await, checks generatedregistry SHA256, rejects imports/missingexports/hashmismatch; no JavaScript numerical fallback. Disposed factory rejects calls.
